segments.mn127:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn127:2.1: Atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn127:2.2: “ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato anuruddhassa pāde sirasā vandāhi [vandāhi, evañca vadehi (sī. pī.)]–
segments.mn127:2.3: ‘pañcakaṅgo, bhante, thapati āyasmato anuruddhassa pāde sirasā vandatī’ti;
segments.mn127:2.5: ‘adhivāsetu kira, bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa svātanāya attacatuttho bhattaṃ;
segments.mn127:2.6: yena ca kira, bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pagevataraṃ āgaccheyya;
segments.mn127:2.7: pañcakaṅgo, bhante, thapati [pañcakaṅgo thapati (sī. pī.)] bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo rājakaraṇīyenā’”ti.
segments.mn127:2.8: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho so puriso pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa paṭissutvā yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn127:2.9: “pañcakaṅgo, bhante, thapati āyasmato anuruddhassa pāde sirasā vandati, evañca vadeti –
segments.mn127:2.10: ‘adhivāsetu kira, bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa svātanāya attacatuttho bhattaṃ;
segments.mn127:2.11: yena ca kira, bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pagevataraṃ āgaccheyya;
segments.mn127:2.12: pañcakaṅgo, bhante, thapati bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo rājakaraṇīyenā’”ti.
segments.mn127:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā anuruddho tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.mn127:3.2: Atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
segments.mn127:3.3: Atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.mn127:3.4: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn127:4.1: “Idha maṃ, bhante, therā bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā evamāhaṃsu –
segments.mn127:4.2: ‘appamāṇaṃ, gahapati, cetovimuttiṃ bhāvehī’ti [appamāṇā gahapati cetovimutti bhāvetabbāti (ka.)].
segments.mn127:4.5: Yā cāyaṃ, bhante, appamāṇā cetovimutti yā ca mahaggatā cetovimutti –
segments.mn127:4.6: ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca, udāhu ekatthā byañjanameva nānan”ti?
segments.mn127:5.1: “Tena hi, gahapati, taṃ yevettha paṭibhātu. Apaṇṇakante ito bhavissatī”ti.
segments.mn127:5.3: ‘yā cāyaṃ appamāṇā cetovimutti yā ca mahaggatā cetovimutti ime dhammā ekatthā byañjanameva nānan’”ti.
segments.mn127:6.1: “Yā cāyaṃ, gahapati, appamāṇā cetovimutti yā ca mahaggatā cetovimutti ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca.
segments.mn127:6.2: Tadamināpetaṃ, gahapati, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca”.
segments.mn127:7.2: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ; iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:7.5: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ; iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:8.2: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:8.4: Idha pana, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:8.5: Ayampi [ayaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] vuccati, gahapati, mahaggatā cetovimutti.
segments.mn127:8.6: Idha pana, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:8.8: Idha pana, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:8.10: Idha pana, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ mahārajjaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:8.12: Idha pana, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā mahārajjāni mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:8.14: Idha pana, gahapati, bhikkhu yāvatā samuddapariyantaṃ pathaviṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:8.16: Iminā kho etaṃ, gahapati, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānābyañjanā ca.
segments.mn127:9.3: Idha, gahapati, ekacco ‘parittābhā’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:9.4: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parittābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn127:9.5: Idha pana, gahapati, ekacco ‘appamāṇābhā’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:9.6: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā appamāṇābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn127:9.7: Idha pana, gahapati, ekacco ‘saṃkiliṭṭhābhā’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:9.8: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā saṃkiliṭṭhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn127:9.9: Idha pana, gahapati, ekacco ‘parisuddhābhā’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:9.10: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parisuddhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn127:10.1: “Hoti kho so, gahapati, samayo, yā tā devatā ekajjhaṃ sannipatanti, tāsaṃ ekajjhaṃ sannipatitānaṃ vaṇṇanānattañhi kho paññāyati no ca ābhānānattaṃ.
segments.mn127:10.2: Seyyathāpi, gahapati, puriso sambahulāni telappadīpāni ekaṃ gharaṃ paveseyya.
segments.mn127:10.3: Tesaṃ ekaṃ gharaṃ pavesitānaṃ accinānattañhi kho paññāyetha, no ca ābhānānattaṃ;
segments.mn127:10.4: evameva kho, gahapati, hoti kho so samayo, yā tā devatā ekajjhaṃ sannipatanti tāsaṃ ekajjhaṃ sannipatitānaṃ vaṇṇanānattañhi kho paññāyati, no ca ābhānānattaṃ.
segments.mn127:11.1: “Hoti kho so, gahapati, samayo, yā tā devatā tato vipakkamanti, tāsaṃ tato vipakkamantīnaṃ vaṇṇanānattañceva paññāyati ābhānānattañca.
segments.mn127:11.2: Seyyathāpi, gahapati, puriso tāni sambahulāni telappadīpāni tamhā gharā nīhareyya.
segments.mn127:11.3: Tesaṃ tato nīhatānaṃ [nīharantānaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] accinānattañceva paññāyetha ābhānānattañca;
segments.mn127:11.4: evameva kho, gahapati, hoti kho so samayo, yā tā devatā tato vipakkamanti, tāsaṃ tato vipakkamantīnaṃ vaṇṇanānattañceva paññāyati ābhānānattañca.
segments.mn127:12.1: “Na kho, gahapati, tāsaṃ devatānaṃ evaṃ hoti –
segments.mn127:12.2: ‘idaṃ amhākaṃ niccanti vā dhuvanti vā sassatan’ti vā, api ca yattha yattheva tā [yā (ka.)] devatā abhinivisanti tattha tattheva tā devatā abhiramanti.
segments.mn127:12.3: Seyyathāpi, gahapati, makkhikānaṃ kājena vā piṭakena vā harīyamānānaṃ na evaṃ hoti –
segments.mn127:12.4: ‘idaṃ amhākaṃ niccanti vā dhuvanti vā sassatan’ti vā, api ca yattha yattheva tā [yā (ka.)] makkhikā abhinivisanti tattha tattheva tā makkhikā abhiramanti;
segments.mn127:12.5: evameva kho, gahapati, tāsaṃ devatānaṃ na evaṃ hoti –
segments.mn127:12.6: ‘idaṃ amhākaṃ niccanti vā dhuvanti vā sassatan’ti vā, api ca yattha yattheva tā devatā abhinivisanti tattha tattheva tā devatā abhiramantī”ti.
segments.mn127:13.1: Evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sabhiyo kaccāno [kaccāyano (sī.)] āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn127:13.3: Atthi ca me ettha uttariṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ.
segments.mn127:13.4: Yā tā, bhante, devatā ābhā sabbā tā parittābhā udāhu santettha ekaccā devatā appamāṇābhā”ti?
segments.mn127:13.5: “Tadaṅgena kho, āvuso kaccāna, santettha ekaccā devatā parittābhā, santi panettha ekaccā devatā appamāṇābhā”ti.
segments.mn127:14.1: “Ko nu kho, bhante anuruddha, hetu ko paccayo yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ santettha ekaccā devatā parittābhā, santi panettha ekaccā devatā appamāṇābhā”ti?
segments.mn127:14.2: “Tena hāvuso kaccāna, taṃyevettha paṭipucchissāmi. Yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
segments.mn127:14.4: yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yocāyaṃ [yopāyaṃ (ka.)] bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.5: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā”ti?
segments.mn127:14.6: “Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.9: yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā rukkhamūlāni ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yocāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.10: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā”ti?
segments.mn127:14.11: “Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.13: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, āvuso kaccāna, yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yocāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.14: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā”ti?
segments.mn127:14.15: “Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.17: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, āvuso kaccāna, yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā gāmakkhettāni ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yocāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ mahārajjaṃ ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.18: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā”ti?
segments.mn127:14.19: “Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ mahārajjaṃ ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.21: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, āvuso kaccāna, yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā ekaṃ mahārajjaṃ ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yocāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā mahārajjāni ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.22: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā”ti?
segments.mn127:14.23: “Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā mahārajjāni ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.25: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, āvuso kaccāna, yvāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā dve vā tīṇi vā mahārajjāni ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati, yocāyaṃ bhikkhu yāvatā samuddapariyantaṃ pathaviṃ ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.26: imāsaṃ ubhinnaṃ cittabhāvanānaṃ katamā cittabhāvanā mahaggatatarā”ti?
segments.mn127:14.27: “Yvāyaṃ, bhante, bhikkhu yāvatā samuddapariyantaṃ pathaviṃ ‘mahaggatan’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati –
segments.mn127:14.29: “Ayaṃ kho, āvuso kaccāna, hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ santettha ekaccā devatā parittābhā, santi panettha ekaccā devatā appamāṇābhā”ti.
segments.mn127:15.2: Atthi ca me ettha uttariṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ.
segments.mn127:15.3: Yāvatā [yā tā (ka.)], bhante, devatā ābhā sabbā tā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā udāhu santettha ekaccā devatā parisuddhābhā”ti?
segments.mn127:15.4: “Tadaṅgena kho, āvuso kaccāna, santettha ekaccā devatā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā, santi panettha ekaccā devatā parisuddhābhā”ti.
segments.mn127:16.1: “Ko nu kho, bhante, anuruddha, hetu ko paccayo, yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ santettha ekaccā devatā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā, santi panettha ekaccā devatā parisuddhābhā”ti?
segments.mn127:16.3: Upamāyapidhekacce [upamāyamidhekacce (ka.)] viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
segments.mn127:16.4: Seyyathāpi, āvuso kaccāna, telappadīpassa jhāyato telampi aparisuddhaṃ vaṭṭipi aparisuddhā.
segments.mn127:16.5: So telassapi aparisuddhattā vaṭṭiyāpi aparisuddhattā andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati;
segments.mn127:16.6: evameva kho, āvuso kaccāna, idhekacco bhikkhu ‘saṃkiliṭṭhābhā’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati,
segments.mn127:16.7: tassa kāyaduṭṭhullampi na suppaṭippassaddhaṃ hoti, thinamiddhampi na susamūhataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccampi na suppaṭivinītaṃ hoti.
segments.mn127:16.8: So kāyaduṭṭhullassapi na suppaṭippassaddhattā thinamiddhassapi na susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassapi na suppaṭivinītattā andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati.
segments.mn127:16.9: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā saṃkiliṭṭhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn127:16.10: Seyyathāpi, āvuso kaccāna, telappadīpassa jhāyato telampi parisuddhaṃ vaṭṭipi parisuddhā.
segments.mn127:16.11: So telassapi parisuddhattā vaṭṭiyāpi parisuddhattā na andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati;
segments.mn127:16.12: evameva kho, āvuso kaccāna, idhekacco bhikkhu ‘parisuddhābhā’ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
segments.mn127:16.13: Tassa kāyaduṭṭhullampi suppaṭippassaddhaṃ hoti, thinamiddhampi susamūhataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccampi suppaṭivinītaṃ hoti.
segments.mn127:16.14: So kāyaduṭṭhullassapi suppaṭippassaddhattā thinamiddhassapi susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassapi suppaṭivinītattā na andhandhaṃ viya jhāyati.
segments.mn127:16.15: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parisuddhābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn127:16.16: Ayaṃ kho, āvuso kaccāna, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena tāsaṃ devatānaṃ ekaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapannānaṃ santettha ekaccā devatā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā, santi panettha ekaccā devatā parisuddhābhā”ti.
segments.mn127:17.1: Evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sabhiyo kaccāno āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn127:17.4: ‘evaṃ me sutan’ti vā ‘evaṃ arahati bhavitun’ti vā;
segments.mn127:17.5: atha ca pana, bhante, āyasmā anuruddho ‘evampi tā devatā, itipi tā devatā’ tveva bhāsati.
segments.mn127:17.7: ‘addhā āyasmatā anuruddhena tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ sannivutthapubbañceva sallapitapubbañca sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbā’”ti.
segments.mn127:17.8: “Addhā kho ayaṃ, āvuso kaccāna, āsajja upanīya vācā bhāsitā,
segments.mn127:17.10: ‘dīgharattaṃ kho me, āvuso kaccāna, tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ sannivutthapubbañceva sallapitapubbañca sākacchā ca samāpajjitapubbā’”ti.
segments.mn127:18.1: Evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sabhiyo kaccāno pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn127:18.3: yaṃ tvañceva taṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pahāsi [pajahasi (ka.)], mayañcimaṃ [yampimaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] dhammapariyāyaṃ alatthamhā savanāyā”ti.

lines: Tattha evamāhaṃsūti tassa upāsakassa aphāsukakālo ahosi, tadā upasaṅkamitvā evamāhaṃsu.
Ekatthāti appamāṇāti vā mahaggatāti vā jhānameva cittekaggatāyeva evaṃ vuccatīti imaṃ sandhāya evamāha.
Yāvatā ekaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ mahaggatanti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharatīti ekarukkhamūlapamāṇaṭṭhānaṃ kasiṇanimittena ottharitvā tasmiṃ kasiṇanimitte mahaggatajjhānaṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
Mahaggatanti panassa ābhogo natthi, kevalaṃ mahaggatajjhānapavattivasena panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
Iminā kho etaṃ gahapati pariyāyenāti iminā kāraṇena.

Ettha hi appamāṇāti vuttānaṃ brahmavihārānaṃ nimittaṃ na vaḍḍhati, ugghāṭanaṃ na jāyati, tāni jhānāni abhiññānaṃ vā nirodhassa vā pādakāni na honti, vipassanāpādakāni pana vaṭṭapādakāni bhavokkamanāni ca honti.
“Mahaggatā”ti vuttānaṃ pana kasiṇajjhānānaṃ nimittaṃ vaḍḍhati, ugghāṭanaṃ jāyati, samatikkamā honti, abhiññāpādakāni nirodhapādakāni vaṭṭapādakāni bhavokkamanāni ca honti.
Evamime dhammā nānatthā, appamāṇā mahaggatāti evaṃ nānābyañjanā ca.
Idāni mahaggatasamāpattito nīharitvā bhavūpapattikāraṇaṃ dassento catasso kho imātiādimāha.
Parittābhāti pharitvā jānantassa ayamābhogo atthi, parittābhesu pana devesu nibbattikāraṇaṃ jhānaṃ bhāvento evaṃ vutto.
Parittābhā siyā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā honti siyā parisuddhābhā, appamāṇābhā siyā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā honti siyā parisuddhābhā.

Suppamatte vā sarāvamatte vā kasiṇaparikammaṃ katvā samāpattiṃ nibbattetvā pañcahākārehi āciṇṇavasibhāvo paccanīkadhammānaṃ suṭṭhu aparisodhitattā dubbalameva samāpattiṃ vaḷañjitvā appaguṇajjhāne ṭhito kālaṃ katvā parittābhesu nibbattati, vaṇṇo panassa paritto ceva hoti saṃkiliṭṭho ca.

Pañcahi panākārehi āciṇṇavasibhāvo paccanīkadhammānaṃ suṭṭhu parisodhitattā suvisuddhaṃ samāpattiṃ vaḷañjitvā paguṇajjhāne ṭhito kālaṃ katvā parittābhesu nibbattati, vaṇṇo panassa paritto ceva hoti parisuddho ca.
Evaṃ parittābhā siyā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā honti siyā parisuddhābhā.
Kasiṇe pana vipulaparikammaṃ katvā samāpattiṃ nibbattetvā pañcahākārehi āciṇṇavasibhāvoti sabbaṃ purimasadisameva veditabbaṃ.
Evaṃ appamāṇābhā siyā saṃkiliṭṭhābhā honti siyā parisuddhābhāti.
No ca ābhānānattanti āloke nānattaṃ na paññāyati.

Tattha tatthevāti sappimadhuphāṇitādīnaṃ sulabhaṭṭhānato loṇapūtimacchādīnaṃ ussannaṭṭhānaṃ nītā “pubbe amhākaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ phāsukaṃ, tattha sukhaṃ vasimhā, idha loṇaṃ vā no bādhati pūtimacchagandho vā sīsarogaṃ uppādetī”ti evaṃ cittaṃ anuppādetvā tattha tattheva ramanti.
Idāni taṃ kāraṇaṃ pucchanto ko nu kho, bhantetiādimāha.
Dīgharattaṃ kho meti thero kira pāramiyo pūrento isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā samāpattiṃ nibbattetvā nirantaraṃ tīṇi attabhāvasatāni brahmaloke paṭilabhi, taṃ sandhāyetaṃ āha.

lines: Upasaṅkamitvā evamāhaṃsūti vuttaṃ upasaṅkamanakāraṇaṃ dassento,“tassa upāsakassa aphāsukakālo ahosī”ti āha.
Yadi vā te dhammā nānatthā, yadi vā ekatthā, yaṃ tattha avirajjhanakaṃ, taṃ taṃyeva paṭibhātūti yojanā.
Jhānamevāti appamāṇajjhānameva,“cetovimuttī”ti pana vuttattā cittekaggatāyeva evaṃ vuccatīti upāsakassa adhippāyo.
Yāvatā majjhanhike kāle chāyā pharati, nivāte paṇṇāni patanti, ettāvatā “rukkhamūlan”ti vuccatīti evaṃ vuttaṃ ekarukkhamūlappamāṇaṭṭhānaṃ.
Kasiṇanimittena ottharitvāti kasiṇārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjanto tasmiṃ kasiṇa … pe … viharatīti vutto.
Kāmaṃ samāpattikkhaṇe ābhogo natthi tato pana pubbe vā siyā so ābhogo, tampi sandhāya mahaggatanti keci.
Idāni tāsaṃ cetovimuttīnaṃ satipi kenaci visesena abhede visayādito labbhamānabhedaṃ dassetuṃ,“etthā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Nimittugghāṭasseva abhāvato arūpajjhānānaṃ anadhiṭṭhānatāya nirodhassa pādakāni na hontīti.
Upapajjanavaseneva taṃ taṃ bhavaṃ okkamati etehīti bhavokkamanāni.
Ugghāṭanassa labbhanato arūpajjhānopari samatikkamo hotīti ayameva viseso.
Kāmañcettha appamāṇasamāpattitopi nīharitvā vakkhamānabhavūpapattikāraṇaṃ dassetuṃ sakkā, aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana kasiṇajhānatova nīharitvā yojanā katāti tathā vuttaṃ.
Atha vā mahaggatagahaṇenettha appamāṇāti vuttabrahmavihārānampi saṅgaho veditabbo tassā samaññāya ubhayesampi sādhāraṇabhāvato.
Evaṃ vuttoti asatipi tathārūpe ābhoge “parittābhāti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharatī”ti vutto.

Appamāṇaṃ katvā kasiṇaṃ vaḍḍhentassa kasiṇavaḍḍhanavasena bahulīkārasambhavato siyā jhānassa balavataratā, tadabhāve ca dubbalatā, āciṇṇavasitāya pana paccanīkadhammānaṃ sammā aparisodhane vattabbameva natthīti pañcahākārehi jhānassa appaguṇataṃ dassento,“suppamatte vā”tiādimāha.
Jhānassa appānubhāvatāya eva tannimittā pabhāpi appatarā aparisuddhāva hotīti āha –
Tatthāpi kasiṇassa parittabhāvena vaṇṇassa parittatā, parittārammaṇāya anurūpatāya vā nimittaṃ pabhāmaṇḍalakampi parittameva siyāti adhippāyo.
Vaṇṇanānattanti yadi pītaṃ yadi lohitaṃ yadi vā odātanti sarīravaṇṇanānattaṃ.
Tadaṅgenāti vā tassā parittatāya appamāṇatāya ca ābhākāraṇaṃ, taṃ pana atthato bhavūpapattikāraṇamevāti āha –
